description: Cac dac ta chuong trinh don gian (mo phong truy cap mang trong module Inventory) dung cho dong co Bounded Model Checking (BMC) tu viet o python/bmc_engine.py. Moi chuong trinh mo ta mot vong lap truy cap mang catalog[base_index + i] voi i la bien vong lap duoc 'unwind' (mo cuon) toi da 'unwind_bound' buoc. Neu 'symbolic_base' = true, base_index la mot BIEN TUONG TRUNG (symbolic) bi rang buoc trong [0, array_size), va BMC se dung Z3 de tim xem CO TON TAI gia tri base_index nao lam truy cap vuot bien hay khong (bai toan EXISTS, phu hop voi SAT solving). Neu 'symbolic_base' = false, base_index la hang so co dinh 'fixed_base'.

programs.description: Duyet toan bo catalog tu dau: for (i = 0; i < array_size; i++) access catalog[i]. Vong lap dung chinh xac bang kich thuoc mang.
Loi off-by-one kinh dien: for (i = 0; i <= array_size; i++) access catalog[i] - dieu kien dung dung '<=' thay vi '<', truy cap catalog[array_size] la vuot bien.

Truy cap catalog[base_index + i] voi base_index la tham so dau vao nguoi dung (vi du: vi tri bat dau tim kiem phan trang - pagination offset), KHONG duoc kiem tra rang buoc truoc vong lap noi bo quet them 5 phan tu.
Giong BMC-03 nhung da them dieu kien tien xu ly gioi han base_index <= array_size - unwind_bound (kiem tra truoc vong lap) -> an toan trong pham vi unwind da cho.
